{{External|rs|dw=Green Dragonhide Leather}} {{Infobox Item |name = Green dragon leather |image = [[File:Green dragon leather.png]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = It's a piece of prepared green dragonhide. |value = 50 |weight = 3.175 |exchange = Yes |id = 1745 }} [[File:Green dragon leather detail.png|120px|left]] '''Green dragon leather''' is used in the [[Crafting]] skill to make [[green dragonhide armour]]. It can be created by giving a [[green dragonhide]] to a [[tanner]]. Tanners can be found in [[Al Kharid]], the [[Ranging Guild]], [[Forthos Dungeon]], [[Kebos Lowlands]], [[Auburnvale]], [[Canifis]], and the [[Crafting Guild]]. Alternatively, green dragon leather can be made using the [[Tan Leather spell]].
